SELECT snap.high AS highRiskCount, ROUND(snap.high * 100.0 / NULLIF(snap.total, 0), 2) AS churnRate, ROUND(100.0 * acc.conv / NULLIF(acc.itv, 0), 1) AS conversionRate, acc.revenue AS attributedRevenue FROM
(SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'ROLE_USER') AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH') AS high FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND scored_at <= NOW() ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC, churn_score_id DESC) l) snap,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.is_control) AS itv, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.is_control AND o.converted) AS conv, COALESCE(SUM(o.revenue_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.is_control AND o.converted), 0) AS revenue FROM retention_intervention r JOIN intervention_outcome o ON o.intervention_id = r.intervention_id WHERE r.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND r.created_at + INTERVAL '7 days' <= NOW()) acc

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND scored_at <= NOW() ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC, churn_score_id DESC
) SELECT risk_level AS riskLevel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM latest GROUP BY risk_level

SELECT risk_type AS riskType, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS count FROM churn_score WHERE scored_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND scored_at <= NOW() -- ML은 전원 예측이라 그대로 세면 항상 전체 인원 = 무의미. 고위험 예측만 신호로 취급 AND (source = 'RULE' OR risk_level = 'HIGH') GROUP BY risk_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT MAX(scored_at) FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at <= NOW()

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND NOT is_control) AS sentToday, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND NOT is_control AND action_type = 'PUSH') AS sentPushToday,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_coupons WHERE issued_at::date = CURRENT_DATE) AS sentCouponToday, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND is_control) AS controlToday, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM intervention_outcome io JOIN retention_intervention r2 ON r2.intervention_id = io.intervention_id WHERE io.converted AND NOT r2.is_control ) AS convertedCount FROM retention_intervention

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND scored_at <= NOW() ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC, churn_score_id DESC
) SELECT COUNT(*) AS highTotal, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retention_intervention ri WHERE ri.user_id = l.user_id) ) AS highCovered FROM latest l WHERE risk_level = 'HIGH'

WITH rule_u AS ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND scored_at <= NOW() ), ml_u AS ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'ML' AND scored_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rule_u r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ml_u m WHERE m.user_id = r.user_id)) AS ruleOnly, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ml_u m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rule_u r WHERE r.user_id = m.user_id)) AS mlOnly, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ml_u m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rule_u r WHERE r.user_id = m.user_id)) AS both, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retention_intervention WHERE risk_type = 'ML_HIGH') AS blindspotSent, (SELECT MAX(scored_at) FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'ML') AS lastMlRunAt

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, risk_level FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND scored_at <= NOW() ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC, churn_score_id DESC
) SELECT CASE WHEN um.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'MEMBER' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS segment, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN l.risk_level = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high FROM latest l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ) um ON um.user_id = l.user_id GROUP BY segment

SELECT metricDate, churnRate FROM ( SELECT metric_date AS metricDate, churn_rate AS churnRate FROM churn_daily_metric WHERE metric_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY metric_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent ORDER BY metricDate ASC

SELECT ri.action_type AS actionType, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ri.is_control THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS treatPct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ri.is_control AND io.converted THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ri.is_control THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS controlPct,
SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted THEN COALESCE(io.revenue_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue FROM retention_intervention ri
JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id
WHERE ri.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND ri.created_at + INTERVAL '7 days' <= NOW() GROUP BY ri.action_type ORDER BY revenue DESC

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, score, risk_level, risk_type FROM churn_score WHERE source = 'RULE' AND scored_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND scored_at <= NOW() ORDER BY user_id, scored_at DESC, churn_score_id DESC ) SELECT l.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, l.score AS score, l.risk_level AS riskLevel, l.risk_type AS riskType, CASE WHEN um.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS isMember FROM latest l JOIN users u ON u.user_id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ) um ON um.user_id = l.user_id ORDER BY l.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
